204: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. After life there is more. The end is just the beginning.

Herbert West has a good head on his shoulders...and another one on his desk.

When there’s murder on the streets, everyone is a suspect.

The strangest trio ever to track a killer.

No Law. No Rules. No Order.
3276: A New York City beautician is mistakenly hired as the school teacher for the children of the president of a small Eastern European country.
3532: Urban horticulturalist Brontë Mitchell has her eye on a gorgeous apartment, but the building's board will rent it only to a married couple. Tum Tum, Colt and Rocky Ready for a Ninja Summer!

All's fair in the war of love.

A little deception at the reception.
4812: Rick Riker is a nerdy teen imbued with superpowers by a radioactive dragonfly. And because every hero needs a nemesis, enter Lou Landers, aka the villainously goofy Hourglass.
The greatest Superhero movie of all time! (not counting all the others)

There's no such thing as an overnight success. Brantley Foster took two weeks.
5324: A fisheries expert is approached by a consultant to help realize a sheik's vision of bringing the sport of fly-fishing to the desert and embarks on an upstream journey of faith and fish to prove the impossible possible.

Danger, intrigue, romance...and a touch of kinkiness!

The battle of wits begins. Whose side are you on?
6604: Suffering from a severe case of depression, toy company CEO Walter Black begins using a beaver hand puppet to help him open up to his family. With his father seemingly going insane, adolescent son Porter pushes for his parents to get a divorce.
He's here to save Walter's life.

She's going from straight A's to getting her first F.
7116: Chicklet is a sixteen-year old tomboy who's desperate to be part of the in-crowd of Malibu beach surfers. She's the typical American girl - except for one little problem: her personality is split into more slices than a pepperoni pizza.

The only way out is down.
7628: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. What if your life depended on a stranger?

The man of "True Grit" is back and look who's got him!
8396: An unemployed man finds his life sinking more and more into trouble as he hides his situation from his family and friends.
8652: A year in the life of Alice Klieg, a woman with Borderline personality disorder who wins the Mega Millions lottery, quits her meds and buys her own talk show.
Alice is going to be on TV whether you like it or not.

The judge sentenced slumlord Louie Kritski to six months in his own building. He would have been better off in jail.
9420: Drunk and disillusioned Roman, Marcellus Gallio, wins Jesus' robe in a dice game after the crucifixion. The first motion picture in CinemaScope--the modern miracle you see without glasses!

Every life has a breaking point.

11212: During the First Lebanon War in 1982, a lone tank and a paratroopers platoon are dispatched to search a hostile town.

The movie that has no limits of evil!
12492: Fando and his partially paralysed lover Lis search for the mythical city of Tar.

Miracles are closer than you think.

Dona Juana, first lady of the queen

Double rates for women... because a woman is always double-trouble!

Coincidence doesn't exist, everything happens for a reason.

Everyone has a secret to die for.

Claudia, a run-down ex-cop, and a parapsychology reporter put together the clues to discover Angela's whereabouts
Trying to reach the limits of evil... But evil has no limits.

A bizarre descent into hell from the creator of Re-Animator.
18380: Germans kidnap an American major and try to convince him that World War II is over, so that they can get details about the Allied invasion of Europe out of him.
"Give Me Any American for 36 Hours And I'll Give You Back a Traitor"
18636: A tough nightclub bouncer struggling to raise his 8-year-old daughter is forced to go undercover after an unfortunate event.
18892: After a young woman is kidnapped, her captors soon come to realize that in fact they may be the ones in danger and this young woman has a dark secret inside her.

A Road Trip Movie to Die For.

22220: Story of the lives of three Soviet pilots who are united by disaster in a small town in the mountains.
22732: A mega-platinum, aging rock star's supermodel wife is abducted by pirates while vacationing in Chile.
Rock Out with Your Glock Out
22988: A teen faces a night of terror when three malevolent trick-or-treaters come knocking at her door.
23244: In the Fabulous Thirties, Doc Savage and his five Amazing Adventurers are sucked into the mystery of Doc's father disappearing in the wilds of South America. 23500: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

bachpan ke sapne... lag gaye apne!!!

Three pioneers, one vision: the birth of IVF.

Sometimes you need to get lost.

Son Gokû / Son Gohan / Son Goten (voice)

26828: A son sets out to look for the man responsible for his father's disappearance, which is connected to a stolen diamond. Eventually, he steals the villain's diamond and also runs away with his sister.

27340: When her son is accused of raping and trying to murder his ex-wife, Alicia embarks on a journey that will change her life forever.

Fatherhood or fatherland. Love or hate.

A family... in an unusual situation.

Never lose touch with your roots.
29388: A 70-year-old woman transforms into her 24-year-old self after she's photographed at a studio, changing her life and those of the people around her forever.

Jake Livingston had to grow up fast... because his mother didn't.

You can’t hide from an evil that lives within.

After staging a daring robbery, he makes off with not only the baroness's ring but also her heart.
He stole her jewels -- but that wasn't all!

I AM GOD, GOD IS GREAT

Driven by hope. Bound by love.

Known Is A Drop, Unknown Is An Ocean!

Hideo Nishi, Director of the Okayama Prefectural Police

Adventure Beyond the Edge of Time
32972: Having fled to Mexico from the U.S. many years ago for killing his father's murderer, Martin Brady travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for his Mexican boss, strongman Governor Cipriano Castro. A Face...A Man...A Motion Picture as Proud and Violent as Tom Lea's Bold and Powerful Novel!
33228: Daredevil sailor Sinbad embarks on a voyage across the Seven Seas to find the lost riches of Alexander the Great. BRAVE in Adventure! BOLD in Love!
33484: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.
33740: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.
33996: Egon and his two cronies managed to sneak a fortune with them to Spain. Here they live a life in a whirl of pleasures, but they are not truly happy. 34252: Hayat, a 12-year-old strong-willed girl, lives in a poor fishing village governed by dark tradition, in which every family must give away a daughter to the sea creatures who inhabit the waters near by. Bound by tradition. Controlled by no one.
34508: In the 1920s, the Provence is a magnet for immigrants seeking work in the quarries or in the agriculture. Banned for decades! The most notorious Japanese horror film ever made!
35020: Dr. Priyadarshan, a middle class man, silently goes through the pangs of hyperactivity and ADHD that entangles him into a series of coincidental events. He then meets Priscilla, a feisty, constantly doubtful and depressed girl.

35532: A sex and drug addicted young man who is forced into a Christian-run ministry in an attempt to cure him of his "gay affliction", where instead he is faced with the truth in his heart and spirit.
35788: Sometime in the distant future, a fledgling band gets an opportunity for a breakthrough, if they can make it in time to a faraway planet to perform in a very popular club.
They're Lost and Loose in Outer Space.
36044: Malcom McDowell, Lou Diamond Phillips and Robert Englund star in three separate stories set in an eerie mental asylum.
36300: Dreaming of ascending the underworld ladder and gaining revenge on his sadistic boss, Sal, a Mafia flunky, Frankie, tries to take a step in the right direction by "saving" an exploited, drug-addicted porn actress, Margaret.
36556: In 2020, following the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7. 36812: Years of warfare end in a Japan unified under the Tokugawa shogunate, and samurai spy Sasuke Sarutobi, tired of conflict, longs for peace. 37324: A listless grand-daughter, Chance Sinclair, is sentenced to live with her draconian grand-father, August after a violent incident at school and begins to question the source of her families immense wealth and power. 37836: After being abducted and taken to a desolate house, a girl sets out to rescue her friend and escape from their malicious kidnapper.

38348: A serial murderer has brutally killed several policemen and their pregnant wives. 39116: While on tour in Germany, a rock star falls in love with concert promoter. But when the police arrest him for murder, he must escape and prove his innocence to win back his beloved's heart.

He had to fight for everything he owned ... except this woman's lips !
39628: Cossetted and bored, Barbara Barry is finally sent off to school by her busy if doting widowed soap manufacturer father. When her nurse is injured en route, Barbara finds herself alone in town, ending up as part of radio song-and-dance act Dolan and Dolan sponsored by a rival soap company.
ARE YOU AN ARMFUL OF HEAVEN ON EARTH? ...YOU ARE---BUT DEFINITELY!
39884: Passionate romance, brutal treachery, and selfless nobility are set against the background of Napoleon’s 1810 invasion of Portugal.
40140: Spain, 1982. 40396: Ailing from a sickness that threatens to silence her forever, Umm Kalthoum, the greatest Egyptian singer the world has ever known, takes to the stage one final time for her most important performance yet, one with the potential to heal a nation broken by the shadow of a great defeat. The voice they couldn't silence. The star they couldn't contain.
The president Gamal and El Nasser
40652: A teenager pretends to be dying from cancer as a way to cope with the realities of his daily existence and his father's terminal illness.
The only thing he cares about is not caring.
40908: After the Byzantine emperor's brother, Knight Alyon, is killed, Knight Andrea swears revenge and decides to take revenge on Battal Gazi. 41164: This is the story of Erin Brockovich's investigation into a chemical spill spirals into an indictment of the entire system meant to protect drinking water, revealing cover-ups at the highest levels of government.
Self - Dr., director of the West VA Bureau of Public Health

41676: Shekhar is new to the block and it doesn't take long before the street noise and the children playing nearby push his tolerance to the limit. 42444: Raoul Leduc is a police inspector trailing a spy who plots to kidnap an important American atomic scientist. Joe Victor a gangster who is hired to carry out the abduction, balks when he learns what is at stake and helps Leduc out instead.
THE SCREEN'S TOP "TOUGH GUYS" MEET FACE TO FACE!
42700: A disgraced political journalist placed in the soccer section, Miss Pove is asked to follow the presidential campaign in progress. 42956: Violin teacher Anna Bronsky detects remarkable talent in a student, Alexander. Anna becomes obsessed with mentoring him, neglecting her family and spiralling under mounting pressure. As her fixation overtakes her, all is staked on exam day.
43212: After being transferred from juvenile to adult prison, Mel Blight is taken under the wing of both Mark Shepard, Australia’s most despised criminal, and Warren Murfett, a soon to be paroled inmate. The most powerful man in the Empire has gone insane!

Kin has two former lovers who still pursue her; one she wants to see, and the other she doesn't. But even the one she remembers fondly, when he shows up, proves less than satisfactory.

45516: When a police officer's hunt for a convict on the run takes an unexpected turn, a story filled with emotions, fate and revenge unfolds in front of him.
45772: A Los Angeles newspaperman seeks a woman's sister and finds a black-market baby ring.
NO NAME FOR HER BABY...only a PRICE!
46028: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.
Eight legs, one bite, no chance.
46540: Welcome to the Family of Liars... Cheaters...Murderers? Here's the Sneak Peek of Family Drama, a Dark Comedy Kannada film.
46796: In 1942, the young Jewish girl Misha, her Russian mother Gerusha and her German father Reuven hide from the Germans in a small house in Ardennes, Belgium. 47052: Not-so-smart chatterbox Dulcy Parker does and says all the wrong things, but they right themselves to prove she's not so dumb after all.
A laugh in every line...and a howl in every scene. The Comedy Hit Of The Talking Screen

For every move... a counter move - for every attack... a counter attack!

Trained to protect... He is the perfect assassin

There are also other small things happening in life of other characters.

48332: The Noharas get caught between two rival clans when Himawari swallows a pretty bead that turns out to be a mysterious ball with hidden powers.
48588: A news anchor, a comedian, an actress, and a soccer player with big egos have to travel across the globe to meet the Malawa tribe for a TV show.
48844: Just out of jail, Fai finds a spot on a street corner where other homeless people welcome him. But he doesn’t get much time to settle in. In the meantime, Fai and his friends have other concerns.
49356: Vera, the Mom, is stressed out of her mind and she decides to take a vacation away from her family, so Victor, the dad, has to take time off work to take care of the family.
49612: Millionairess Dorothy Hunter is tired of finding out that her boyfriends love her for her money, and equally weary of losing eligible beaus who don't want to be considered fortune-hunters. This causes numerous complications not only for Dorothy and Tony but for Sylvia, whose own husband Philip is not the most patient of men.
$30,000 A DAY TO SPEND...and nothing to live for!
49868: János is a 35 years old, rich, succesful single man, who plans to go on a long vacation with his brand new car, but he happens to fall in love at first sight…
50380: A greedy TV channel owner tries to rake in the moolah by pitting a reluctant local boxer against a notorious international champion.
50636: Story of a man seeking to avenge the person who rejected him.
50892: To stop the Third Reich and the Nazi war machine from winning World War II and affecting the outcome of the free world, Toulon's indestructible puppets join forces with the masters of psychic powers.
The bloody conclusion to the 'Axis' trilogy!

What a pleasure... and it's all yours!
